Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s inherited effect activate when my opponent has no Digimon in play in their battle area?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Trash 1 digivolution card from the top of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards in play, unsuspend this Digimon.
